item: Leads chips count outlets: two feeds of one site are one independent source, and the scan sees a feed-label count
refs: R146; branch claude/v0-5-plan-j8zvre (PR number at push)
summary: A briefing card's evidence now carries the outlet (the source's domain, one definition shared with OutletMap), and a lead's independent-source count (Home's order, the leads view chips, the quality export) counts outlets, so BBC English and BBC Arabic are one voice. The chips field is distinct_outlets, with evidence_without_outlet saying how many entries from older cached cards could only be counted by feed label, and the view carries outlets_note in place of the feeds note. The J2b guard now also finds len() of a set built from an evidence source label, which turned up and classified two label counts that are outlet labels already (copypasta, coordination); the red-without proof is that a feed-label count fails the scan and the tests.
